strongest_angle: Examine how Americans spend 96 days a year worrying about money based on The Penny Hoarder 2026 Financial Anxiety Barometer Report, and explore how neuroscience and psychology impact our financial stress.

key_facts.fact: Americans spend the equivalent of 96 days a year worried about money, according to The Penny Hoarder’s 2026 Financial Anxiety Barometer Report.
Only 14% of Americans say they feel in control of their finances according to Impause research data.
Neuroscientists can watch the nucleus accumbens light up roughly a second and a half before a person decides to buy something.
A survey found that 62% of consumers who make an impulse purchase end up regretting it.
